[LSER.16.5.1] `count_distinct(cursor)` returns the count of
distinct values seen.

Two samples are the same value exactly when `==` between them is `true`, as two
keys are ([LRST.1.4]). So `-0.0` and `0.0` are one value, and two `Time` samples
are one value when they denote the same UTC instant, whatever their offsets
([LTIM.5.2]).
